resource_contract.conclusion: With the already-qualified LLVM/Clang package targets, clang-relative default embeds the configured clang target path and computes its resource path through the linked Clang Driver. It does not locate or launch clang from PATH at runtime.

build_settings.CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR: not exported for the standalone build

resource_contract.compile_definition: IWYU_RESOURCE_BINARY_PATH="$<TARGET_FILE:clang>" is resolved by CMake into the configured clang executable path; capture this exact resolved macro during later configuration/build and bind it to the qualified target.
resource_contract.runtime_algorithm: Nonempty IWYU_RESOURCE_BINARY_PATH and empty IWYU_RESOURCE_DIR call Driver::GetResourcesPath(IWYU_RESOURCE_BINARY_PATH). If no explicit -resource-dir token exists, append separate -resource-dir and computed-path tokens before any -- separator.
resource_contract.relocation_scope: Moving only the IWYU installation preserves the fixed Clang anchor. This does not establish relocation of LLVM or resource headers, and actual installed/relocated behavior has not run.

override.pass_through: Clang option: do not prefix with -Xiwyu.
override.warning: Use two tokens. HasArg compares complete tokens; -resource-dir=<path> is not recognized as an explicit override by the IWYU guard and can be followed by an automatically injected option.

print.stdout: Effective resource path printed by Driver::BuildCompilation; require exact/canonical equality with the previously qualified Clang resource directory.
print.reason_for_nonzero: ExecuteAction intentionally returns false after the Driver handles this query; main maps false to EXIT_FAILURE. A printed path plus exit 1 is expected at this pin, rather than a generic successful rc=0 probe.
print.stderr: Require no unexpected diagnostic text; this branch exists to avoid additional expected-compiler-job errors.
print.verification: Source-derived prediction only; native stdout/stderr and exit code remain UNVERIFIED.

observable_exit_contract.before_fix: Expect recommendation edits and exit 23, provided analysis reaches normal reporting. Default --error is 1 if no integer is supplied; omitting --error permits exit 0 even with violations.
observable_exit_contract.after_fix: With --error=23, no proposed adds/deletes should produce exit 0 and the correct-includes/fwd-decls summary.

always_control.scope: After normal reporting, nonzero --error_always takes precedence over violations. It is not a guarantee to override frontend/unrecoverable failures.

observable_exit_contract.diagnostics: Capture stdout and stderr separately. Recommendation diffs and actual level-3 IWYU warnings use llvm::errs(); unrecoverable frontend errors exit EXIT_FAILURE. Keep fatal/error diagnostics distinct from the selected recommendation code.
verbosity_traps: The default is 1 unless IWYU_VERBOSE overrides it, so specify the level explicitly.
The level-2 canonical-warning branch is a TODO and emits no warning message; level 3 actually emits the warnings.
Edit counting is inside level-1 add/remove blocks. Level 0 therefore undermines using --error=N as the edit detector.
